links.surface: أحمد بن محمد بن سعيد الكوفي

notes: «قراءة» is a mode of transmission (reading to the shaykh), not a name: left out
«كنت عند أبي عبد الله» : Ibn al-Fadl is present at the Imam's place and the Imam speaks and rules in the scene; whether the Imam is the source or only in the scene is unsettled (rule 11)
«فأين ما روي أن الفقيه لا يعيد الصلاة» : «روي» has no transmitter: not a link

notes: Narrated encounter: «كنت عند أبي عبد الله» with the Imam answering («فقال له: يعيد الصلاة»). Whether the Imam is a source or only in the scene is a case the rules leave open (rule 11); he is written as the last link as imam_in_text
«أخبرنا المنذر بن محمد قراءة»: «قراءة» is a mode word and is left out
